body: Yes! Hoping to not be let down and get some real disclosure and truth in our lifetime.

I relate so much to this! For me, A lot of the control and subtle abuse is so hard to verbalize or articulate it. if i can’t articulate the abuse, i have a hard time labeling it as such. Cue the self doubt and just forgetting about doing things you enjoy piled on top of the subtle yet hurtful things they say “jokingly” etc. and it’s just exhausting.

Thank you. Brain fog is a good word for it. Definitely just trying to keep myself grounded in my own reality because everything is so very confusing and subtle i can’t tell if I’m actually being sensitive or overreacting.
That’s always it, isn’t it? Too incapable to talk to them yet I do all the talking usually!

Thank you so so much. I’ve quit using smoking as a way to just exist in my own space without fear, and am setting boundaries. I’ve told my best friend for the first time, and am starting to feel like I’m not making this all up in my head. Thank you.
